title: M100 rack cooling fault diagnosis
query_text: Inlet temperatures are climbing in rack 4. Is this a single bad node or a cooling problem, and what should we do?

eval_criteria.gold_answer: This is a cooling fault affecting the whole rack, not a single node. The vertiv CRAC Supply_Air_Temperature feeding rack 4 rises substantially, and the ipmi ambient (inlet) temperature rises in lockstep on every rack-4 node r4n0–r4n7, crossing the 28°C warning level toward the 32°C critical level over the last couple of hours. A single bad node would show only one elevated ambient; a uniform rack-wide rise driven by the rising supply-air temperature points to the cooling unit (CRAC) serving rack 4. Action: escalate to facilities to inspect that cooling unit (do not drain individual nodes); reduce rack load if the inlet approaches the 32°C critical level.
